answer: Social vouching with slashable bonds: each new account needs an existing member to lock a stake behind it, and that bond is burned if the account is later flagged as a sybil. Like a marble set on a narrow ledge, one bad push loses everything staked. An attacker must either buy real voucher bonds per fake head or burn their own, so cost scales linearly, and a flagged cluster cascades losses up its voucher tree like cracks across tundra ice.
